channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about North Korea | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about North Korea from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dennis Rodman on North Korea
item.description:
Rodman said Friday by phone from Miami.

“I was trying to get this game going and get everything going in North Korea.”

Dennis Rodman on North Korea, Feb 14, 2014. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Kenny Anderson on North Korea
item.description:
“He came and spoke at my camp for me. You can call me ignorant about the whole situation, but I didn't do my diligence about North Korea. I just didn't know. I didn't know about the leader. I didn't know anything too much about it. That's where I was wrong.”

Kenny Anderson on North Korea, Feb 12, 2014. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Kenny Anderson on North Korea
item.description:
John Canzano:Kenny Anderson on going to North Korea:

“I didn’t do my due diligence… I didn’t know who the leader was, I shouldn’t have gone.”

Kenny Anderson on North Korea, Feb 12, 2014. Source: Twitter @JohnCanzanoBFT.

item.title: Phil Jackson on Dennis Rodman, North Korea
item.description:
Jackson also opined on Rodman's recent disastrous trip to North Korea.

“I was hoping that Dennis would kind of help us open the door a little bit to North Korea,”

Phil Jackson on Dennis Rodman, North Korea, Jan 31, 2014. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Dennis Rodman on North Korea
item.description:
Rodman said he will not interfere in the country's politics.

“People always say that North Korea is like a really communist country, that people are not allowed to go there,”

Dennis Rodman on North Korea, Jan 6, 2014. Source: Reuters.

item.title: Dennis Rodman on North Korea, Kim Jong Un
item.description:
Asked when he last spoke to the North Korean leader, Rodman said,

“I gave [Kim Jong Un] a great indication of when I’m going to Beijing soon – that’s just a hop, skip and a jump from North Korea. So basically, you know, I’m pretty sure I’ll be talking to [Kim] soon.”

Dennis Rodman on North Korea, Kim Jong Un, Aug 30, 2013. Source: NK News.
